title: peucedanum longipedicillatum
intro: Peucedanum longipedicillatum, commonly known as Sichuan torreya or Chinese torreya, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family Apiaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum longipedicillatum include its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
